store.0: I have been involved in undergraduate research since the end of my sophomore year, and it has been a truly eye-opening experience. It has given me a glimpse into how knowledge is created in the tech world, and I feel privileged to be a part of it. As a freshman, I didn't see myself pursuing research, but after being approached by a professor who recognized my coding skills and user experience abilities, I decided to take the leap. It was a great decision, as it has allowed me to explore the intersection of technology and user experience in a meaningful way.
